summary: Order placement 500s are caused by a code regression in the order-service v2.14.0 release dep-5101, deployed 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z. The new MarginCheckValidator throws a NullPointerException ('marginProfile is null') at line 88 for orderType=FNO (F&O) orders, and the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() that previously tolerated/handled this was removed in the same release. Symptoms began at 12:12:31Z and error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~18.4% as a flat step function, affecting only derivatives orders. Dependencies (pricing-engine) are healthy, traffic and CPU are flat, and no relevant config change occurred, ruling out dependency failure, capacity saturation, and data issues. Recommend immediate rollback of dep-5101.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bad deployment: MarginCheckValidator NPEs on F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) at 12:10Z replaced the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator. The new validator dereferences a null marginProfile for orderType=FNO orders, causing an uncaught NPE that returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders. This is a code/regression defect introduced by the release, not a data or infrastructure problem.

causal_chain.claim: Deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0, new MarginCheckValidator) goes live at 12:10Z
First NPE at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) at 12:12:31Z, none before
NPE only for orderType=FNO, marginProfile null for those accounts
error_rate step-jumps 0.2% -> 18.4% at 12:12 and stays flat
HTTP 500 returned to order placement callers

assumptions: The NPE at line 88 is genuinely the new validator dereferencing marginProfile (stack frame matches the class added in the deploy).
marginProfile was never supposed to exist as null for FNO accounts under the old code path (legacy validator handled the null case).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Data issue: margin profile data missing in ledger-db for F&O accounts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A dataset/record problem — marginProfile rows absent for F&O accounts — could make the validator see null and NPE.
assumptions: No evidence of any data mutation was available either way.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: If the data were missing, the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() path would also have failed before 12:10, but there were zero errors before 12:12:31Z (F2, F10). pricing-engine dependency metrics are flat (F8) and no upstream data signal changed. The onset aligns exactly with the deploy, not with any data change.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Capacity/resource saturation on order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Load or resource exhaustion on order-service caused 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: CPU flat ~40% (F6) and request_rate flat ~232 req/s (F7); errors are a deterministic NPE on FNO orders, not timeouts/overload.

facts.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) deployed 12:10Z adding MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin().
First ERROR at 12:12:31Z is an NPE inside MarginCheckValidator.validate, a class added by the deploy.
All errors are on orderType=FNO (F&O) orders with message 'marginProfile is null'.
order-service error_rate step-jumped from ~0.2% to 18.38% at the 12:12 bucket and stayed flat.
CPU (~40%), request_rate (~232 req/s) and pricing-engine error_rate (~0.22%) were all flat — no resource or dependency cause.
The only config change was notification-service email.batch_size, unrelated to orders.
The sole deployment in the window was order-service dep-5101.

timeline.event: First NPE at MarginCheckValidator.validate; errors begin
Errors still ongoing at ~2.5% of all requests failing, flat

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service from v2.14.0 (dep-5101) to the previous version immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: The deploy is the trigger; rollback removes the faulty MarginCheckValidator and should restore order placement for F&O.

recommended_actions.action: Add a null-guard / proper default for marginProfile in MarginCheckValidator before re-releasing, and restore the legacy null-handling behaviour.
recommended_actions.rationale: Root cause is dereferencing a null marginProfile for F&O orders.

recommended_actions.action: Add integration/unit tests covering FNO orders with missing margin profile to the release gate.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents recurrence of the exact regression that shipped undetected.

recommended_actions.action: Add an alert on order-service error_rate step change correlated with deploy events so future bad deploys are caught within minutes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Onset was 12:12 but not reported until 12:22; faster detection limits impact.

data_gaps: No code diff / source for MarginCheckValidator.java line 88 was available, so the exact null-dereference line is inferred from the stack trace message rather than read from source.

No ledger-db or account-data schema/row inspection was performed, so the possibility that marginProfile is legitimately absent for some F&O accounts (and the old code tolerated it) is not independently confirmed.

The first log query result was truncated (272 matches, 30 returned) and the second (154 matches, 30 returned); counts of patterns are from the pattern summaries, but full per-entry coverage of all errors was not retrieved.
No deployment history before 10:00Z was checked, so it is assumed no earlier relevant deploy existed.

findings.statement: order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) went live at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z, adding a new MarginCheckValidator to the validation chain and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(), authored by r.iyer, status live, not rolled back.
order-service ERROR logs begin at 2026-03-03T12:12:31Z with 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88)' and continue through the window.
Every logged error names orderType=FNO, i.e. only F&O (derivatives) orders hit the NPE; no other order types appear in the error set.
The error message is 'java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>' returned as HTTP 500 on order placement.

refs.quote: order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account 99733

findings.statement: order-service error_rate was ~0.2% before 12:12 and jumped to 18.38% in the 12:12 bucket, remaining flat ~18.5% through 13:56 — a step change, not a gradual ramp.
order-service CPU stayed flat at ~40% across the whole window (min 36.51, max 43.44); no CPU/resource pressure accompanied the incident.
order-service request_rate stayed flat ~232 req/s (mean 232.19, max 255.8) — no traffic surge, so the error spike is not load-driven.
pricing-engine (the service supplying pricing/market data to order-service) error_rate stayed flat ~0.22% across the entire window and it logged zero WARN+ entries — the dependency did not degrade.
The only config change in the window was notification-service key email.batch_size 200->250 at 11:21Z — unrelated to order placement/margin.
Total error count for the morning window is 272 ERROR entries with the two NPE patterns dominating (150 + 122), all starting at or after 12:12:31Z.

The deploy introduced code that dereferences a marginProfile that is null specifically for FNO orders; the onset (12:12:31) is ~2.5 min after the deploy (12:10:00) with zero NPEs beforehand, and the symptom scope exactly matches the new feature (F&O margin check).

findings.statement: Historical incident HIST-110 for order-service was about ledger-db IOPS throttling causing slow orders/statement timeouts — different symptom (latency, not NPE/500) and different mechanism, so it does not match this incident.
